messages:
emma-support: ACME reports a sudden spike in tail latency and a few 503s this morning. They say traffic suddenly went to EU region from US which added ~350ms. Billing shows token spikes for EU models. Can someone look?

acme-prod-contact: seen ~20 failed requests/min during the window, all started 2025-08-12 09:42 UTC. We didn't change clients.

leo-eng-sre: looking into routing logs now. initial sign: healthcheck probes for US-WEST-2 showed timeouts and then the orchestrator started routing traffic to eu-west-1 as fallback.

maya-platform: surprising — our healthcheck agent has a suppression backoff when a probe times out (to avoid noisy retries). If probes get transiently blocked we won't re-enable for a few minutes. Could explain the sustained failover.

leo-eng-sre: digging into probe logs: 
```
2025-08-12T09:42:01Z probe-agent usw2 -> target=10.5.23.7 status=timeout src_ip=54.22.14.3
2025-08-12T09:42:11Z probe-agent usw2 -> target=10.5.23.7 status=timeout src_ip=54.22.90.12
2025-08-12T09:42:21Z probe-agent usw2 -> target=10.5.23.7 status=timeout src_ip=54.22.14.3
```
IPs are changing every probe. looks like the monitoring egress IP is rotating.

maya-platform: that looks like our monitor is behind a resolver that uses short-lived egress IPs. We recently rolled a NAT housekeeping change that rotates egresss for scale. If the probe target has a source-IP allowlist, packets get dropped.

raj-eng: we shipped a firewall hardening last night that locked down kube node inbound to the known monitor IPs. If monitor IPs rotated, that would cause timeouts.

acme-prod-contact: yes, we do use a strict allowlist on our side for probes. we got alerts about dropped packets at the same time.

leo-eng-sre: ok root cause theory: egress IP rotation + customer allowlist = probe timeouts. timeouts trigger suppression/backoff in the healthcheck controller => orchestrator marks region unhealthy and fails over.

maya-platform: extra wrinkle: there's a bug in suppression logic — when probes alternate between different failing src_ip values the suppression window gets amplified (it accumulates and extends). so failover lasted longer than usual.

infra-bot: deploy 2025-08-12T02:10 -> probes:healthcheck-agent v2.8.1 rolled to us-west-2 :white_check_mark:

raj-eng: action items — rolling a quick fix to revert the firewall hardening for probe ports while we validate IP ranges. also patch suppression logic to not amplify across src_ip variance.

maya-platform: temporary mitigation for customers: 1) allowlist the full monitoring CIDR announced in status page; 2) or disable strict source allowlist for probe ports and use token-based probe auth.

leo-eng-sre: repro steps for eng/support to validate: 
1) run curl from different egress IPs to probe endpoint with same Host header to simulate rotate.
2) confirm healthcheck agent logs a timeout and suppression starts.

Example curl:
```
# from hosts that have different egress IP
curl -v -H "Host: api.redwood-inference.internal" https://10.5.23.7/healthz
```

emma-support: i've told ACME the immediate mitigation (temporarily relax allowlist for probe ports) and that we're rolling a patch. they're ok with temporary change. :thumbsup:

raj-eng: small patch pushed to fix suppression accumulation, will promote to canary in 10m. will also open a postmortem doc.

maya-platform: longer-term: update monitoring network design — publish stable egress IP ranges for probes and add token auth so we don't rely on source IPs. also add a dashboard alert that flags rapid egress IP churn + probe timeouts.

acme-prod-contact: thanks — appreciate quick response. please share ETA on the rollback or patch.

leo-eng-sre: canary rolling now -> if green we'll promote in next 20m. ETA ~30m for full fix.

emma-support: sharing ETA with ACME. will follow up once patch promoted. :eyes:

raj-eng: created ticket INF-4382 and assigned to maya and leo for follow-ups.

maya-platform: logging the repro and adding unit test for suppression logic. night crew, please monitor.

emma-support: closing loop with customer now, will reopen if they still see issues. thanks team.
